conditions: 6 AM- Rise and greet a gorgeous spring morning, Jackson. Our space-bound stone is spinning us towards another sun-sational day of soft-snow shredding. Positive and negative G-forces will be yours for the taking as we carve under near bluebird skies that push temperatures close to record-breaking. Highs will reach the mid-40s on the deck of Corbet's Cabin as Teton Village continues to court the upper 60s. Gusty winds will be blowing from the west-southwest between 5 and 25 mph, with the upper elevations seeing gusts into the 30s. The heatwave rays continue, but let's be honest, you don't mind feelin' em. Because that's the moment when you fall into a sweet daydream delirium. -Lege
